item.title: Police Clear Gar Field After Report
item.description: Prince William County police conducted a precautionary search at Gar-Field High School in Woodbridge on Tuesday after unconfirmed reports that a firearm had been seen inside the building, ultimately finding no weapon and reporting no injuries.

item.title: Publix Is Coming — Just Not Close Enough for Dumfries
item.description: Prince William County officials said Publix is planned for Ashland Square, a long-discussed grocery project residents have tied to food access concerns in the eastern corridor.

item.title: Ethics Questions Follow Woodbridge Democratic Caucus
item.description: Ethics questions surfaced after a Prince William County supervisor briefly offered his government office as a potential ballot-counting site during a contested Woodbridge District Democratic caucus.

item.title: What grocery store do YOU think is coming to North Stafford?
item.description: Stafford County could finally name its long-teased “high-end” grocery store on Feb. 17, 2026, when supervisors hold a public hearing on selling the former Old Moncure Elementary School site at 75 Moncure Lane for a grocery-anchored redevelopment.Stafford County could finally name its long-teased “high-end” grocery store on Feb. 17, 2026, when supervisors hold a public hearing on selling the former Old Moncure Elementary School site at 75 Moncure Lane for a grocery-anchored redevelopment.

item.title: Manassas Tightens Data Center Zoning Rules
item.description: Manassas City Council approved a first reading of a zoning ordinance that tightens development rules for data centers and other large industrial projects, citing noise, appearance, and proximity concerns near residential areas.

item.title: Prince William Debuts Senior Pop-Up Program
item.description: Prince William County is launching its Seniors Without Walls program in February 2026, using pop-up events as an interim step toward a future senior center.

item.title: Fredericksburg Region Adopts First Economic Strategy
item.description: Leaders in the Fredericksburg area are moving forward with the region’s first coordinated economic strategy after an 18-month planning effort aimed at tackling congestion, workforce gaps, and long-term growth.

item.title: Osbourn Students Walk Out Over ICE Policies
item.description: More than 3o0 students at Osbourn High School in Manassas walked out of classes Wednesday afternoon to protest federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement policies, school officials and participants said.
